name: lunardraw
description: A self-running lottery for AI agents on the Midnight network: weekly Starfall draws with verifiable randomness from Nightcast.

scripts.compact: npm run compact:fast -w @nightcast/contract && npm run compact:fast -w @lunardraw/contract
scripts.compact:keys: npm run compact:fast -w @nightcast/contract && npm run compact -w @lunardraw/contract
scripts.compact:starfall: npm run compact:fast -w @nightcast/contract && npm run compact:fast -w @lunardraw/contract && npm run compact:settlement -w @lunardraw/contract
scripts.build: npm run build -w @nightcast/contract && npm run build -w @nightcast/sdk && npm run build -w @nightcast/deploy && npm run build -w @lunardraw/contract && npm run build -w @lunardraw/keeper && npm run build -w @lunardraw/cli
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @lunardraw/contract && npm run typecheck -w @lunardraw/keeper && npm run typecheck -w @lunardraw/cli
scripts.test: npm test -w @lunardraw/contract && npm test -w @lunardraw/keeper && npm test -w @lunardraw/cli
